Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) a labor for which he binds (obligates) himself; [oth. explan.] ib. 112ᵃ <he>מ׳ את עצמו למיתה</he> (Ms. M. <he>מ׳ לו נפשו עליו</he>) he delivered himself to death, i.e. risked his life; (Ms. M. for which he surrendered his life to the employer); <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 279:3">Sifré Deut. 279</cite> <he>מ׳ לך את נפשו</he> he surrendered his life to thee (the employer); a. v. fr.—<he>מ׳ דין על</he> to surrender one’s case against a man (to Providence); v. <cite ref="D00634"><he>דִּין</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to surrender a person to the authorities, to inform against.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 7a:5">Gitt. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>ובידי למָסְרָם למלכות</he> it is in my power to bring them to judgment through the (Roman) government.

<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 7:20">Tosef. Ter. VII, 20</cite> <he>יהרגו כולם ולא יִמְסְרוּ וכ׳</he> let them all suffer death rather than surrender one Israelite &c.; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="M01882"><he>מָסוֹר</he></cite>.—
